name: pignon
description: Routes each prompt to the right Claude model and effort level (Haiku, Sonnet or Opus), with a cache-aware switching policy.

decider.title: Who judges each prompt
decider.description: haiku: ask Haiku about each prompt (default). laya: a model on this Mac judges, and the prompt goes only to Claude (in shadow mode Haiku is also asked, to compare); run /pignon setup once. Falls back to Haiku whenever it is unavailable.

daemon.title: How the local model runs
daemon.description: session: one copy per session, about 1.3 GB each, stopped with the session (default). shared: one copy for every session, stopped after 30 minutes without a prompt. Only matters when the decider is laya.

record.title: Keep a decision log
record.description: off: nothing is written to disk (default). on: one line per decision in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/pignon/decisions/, with the tiers, the judges' answers and timings but none of the prompt, for /pignon stats. Files older than 90 days are removed at each session start, even after you turn this off.

oracle.title: Score the judges against Opus
oracle.description: off: no reference judge (default). on: in shadow mode, Opus is also asked about each judged prompt once its turn has ended, with the input Haiku read; /pignon compare and /pignon stats then say how often Haiku and the local model pick its tier. One Opus call per prompt, about a cent at list price (at most about nine); the stats show what it cost. Turn the decision log on too, or its answers are lost when the session ends.

corpus.title: Keep the prompts, to train a local judge
corpus.description: off: no prompt is written to disk (default). on: the text of each judged prompt (acknowledgements aside, up to 32,000 characters) goes to its own file in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/pignon/corpus/, a folder only you can enter, keyed to its line in the decision log, so a judge can later be trained on this Mac from the oracle's verdicts. Nothing leaves the Mac. Files older than 90 days are removed at each session start, even after you turn this off. Turn the decision log and the oracle on too, in shadow mode, or the prompts have no labels.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: After this long without a request the cache has lapsed, so a switch costs nothing and the cache guard is lifted for the next prompt. auto (default): FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting or ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H when set, else an hour, the safe guess. 5m: an API key, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry with none of those set.
